decisions.rationale: The median-of-three implementation correctly clamps against ordered inclusive bounds, and the committed test passes.
The candidate replaces case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive sorting, and the committed test fails.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, directly violating the specification; the boundary test fails.
The candidate reverses the required test assertion, causing the committed suite to fail even though the implementation returns true.

strategy_update: Continue prioritizing direct agreement among specification, exact diff, and declared test results, using public attestations only as corroboration.
